stops.name: Lake Starnberg
stops.quote: In a privileged location, five minutes' walk from Lake Starnberg, lies the only DEHOGA-classified four-star superior hotel in the region.
stops.english: In a privileged location, five minutes' walk from Lake Starnberg, lies the only DEHOGA-classified four-star superior hotel in the region.

stops.name: Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Starnberg
stops.quote: The privately run Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Starnberg was designed to be accessible, so that all areas in the hotel can also be used by guests with limited mobility.
stops.english: The privately run Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Starnberg was designed to be accessible, so that all areas in the hotel can also be used by guests with limited mobility.

stops.name: gourmet restaurant Aubergine
stops.quote: On the ground floor there is the open lobby, an accessible WC with a baby changing unit, toys and toiletries, as well as the 400m² conference area, the gourmet restaurant Aubergine, the restaurant Oliv's and the Hemingway Bar in English style.
stops.english: On the ground floor there is the open lobby, an accessible WC with a baby changing unit, toys and toiletries, as well as the 400m² conference area, the gourmet restaurant Aubergine, the restaurant Oliv's and the Hemingway Bar in English style.
